nodes.label: Governed Service Identity Concept (not nullable product_id)
nodes.rationale: `manufacturer_name NOT NULL` + `part_number NOT NULL` on `project_quotation_lines` has no counterpart in any reference system, because write-in, G/L-account and text lines are legitimately manufacturer-free everywhere. A correct service path is therefore not 'make product_id nullable' — it requires a governed service identity concept, which is a business/commercial-intent decision the mission preserves as a human gate.

nodes.label: Principle: money implies identity; identity-less implies money-free
nodes.rationale: Derived from Odoo's DB CHECKs: display_type IS NOT NULL OR is_downpayment OR (product_id IS NOT NULL AND product_uom_id IS NOT NULL), and display_type IS NULL OR (product_id IS NULL AND price_unit = 0). All four mature systems admit non-product service identities, so a priced productless line needs a purpose-built uncoupled identity, not a disguised SKU.

nodes.label: Dynamics BC Sales Line Type = G/L Account (priced productless line)
nodes.rationale: The only native priced-productless line, keyed to a G/L account rather than a SKU, with explicit guidance to create an item or resource specifically for that purpose and NOT couple it with a product.

nodes.label: Migration 0012: estimator_understanding_field_reviews (per-field authority)
nodes.rationale: Per (interpretation_id, field_key), so a newer interpretation can never inherit a stale confirmation — the same currentness rule as whole-blob approval. proposed_value/confirmed_value stored separately, source_input_fingerprint binds the decision to its input, decision ∈ {CONFIRMED,EDITED,REJECTED,UNRESOLVED}. Forward-only; 13/13 chain OK; CHECK enforcement proven live; drizzle-derived, not hand-written. Adding 0012 also resolved the 3 previously-frozen STALE pins in migration-baseline-safety (now 9/9).

nodes.label: currentApprovedUnderstandingFacts (single canonical authority resolver)
nodes.rationale: Phase 6B must widen this one resolver so deterministic classification fields can be confirmed while unsupported attributes stay unresolved; 0012 is schema only, so the code half is the remaining work.
